name: Ashenmoor Cohort — another black creature you control
notes: Memory: project_ashenmoor_cohort_another_black_creature_2026-06-22. 'As long as you control another black creature' never matched (parsed 'another' as a subtype). It must count only same-color creatures you control other than the Cohort itself: Ashenmoor Cohort with Vampire Nighthawk gets +1/+1; the sibling Cohorts alone (self must not count) or with only an opponent's creature of their color do not.
